input: Which of Quillmoor Capital, Vellisk Partners and Orrindale Fund has the strongest fintech track record? Give numbers.

rounds.answer:
Quillmoor Capital has the strongest fintech track record of the three, based on the portfolio data. The dataset only counts companies and investment years. It has no returns, exits or valuations, so "strongest" here means the most fintech investments.

| Firm | Fintech companies | Total companies | Investment years |
|---|---|---|---|
| Quillmoor Capital | 6 | 6 (all fintech) | 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2026 |
| Vellisk Partners | 2 | 2 (all fintech) | 2022, 2024 |
| Orrindale Fund | 1 | 2 (the other is proptech) | 2023, 2024 |

Quillmoor also has the longest record, with a fintech investment in every year from 2019 to 2026 except 2021 and 2025. It is the only one of the three with a 2026 deal.
